# Harpy
Harpies, or Uru' Nar, are a species of Humanoids that originate from the planet [textlink="Avatel-Ran." link="AvatelRan"] In appearance, they are small, wispy humanoids with large wings and bird feet, with no hair, and pinfeathers in the places of human hair. Their wings also have three taloned hands on them, which are double opposing, with two thumbs, and one true finger.
## Background When human expansion crossed paths with the Harpy, the harpies had already formed a bustling sector of multispecies trade fueled by an decadent civilian economy and a culture of one-upmanship. This sector, Appalia, still stands independent to this day, mainly due to the might of the Appalia Trade Consulate and the large navy it commands in the name of keeping its borders secure and trade unimpeded. Given the status of the sector, most of the major human corporations never established major footholds in harpy space, but nonetheless, harpies became regulars to Nanotrasen stations, through their own endless desire for improvement and satisfaction.
## Unique Abilities
### Sing your heart out
- Harpies are capable of singing out a tune on the spot with their voice, allowing for you to play music wherever you are, as long as you aren't muffled.
### Take to the skies!
- Harpies can fly with their wings to [color=#1e90ff]increase their movement speed dramatically[/color], at the cost of [color=#FFA500]heavy stamina drain and a temporary inability to use their hands.[/color]
- Their wings give them better acceleration if there is no gravity on the station, but they still can't move without equipment when floating out in space.
## Diet
- Harpies have similar diets to that of humans.
## Benefits
- They [color=#1e90ff]run 10% faster[/color] than other species. - They slash with their claws, dealing [color=#ec3a3a]Piercing [/color]damage.
## Drawbacks
- Due to their digitrade legs, they are [color=#FFA500]unable to wear any type of footwear.[/color] - Harpies also breathe [color=#1e90ff]3 times faster[/color] than other races. - They are very lightweight, making it hard for them to pull any other species. - They take [color=#FFA500]15% more Blunt damage.[/color] - They have [color=#FFA500]weaker bones.[/color]
